question.text: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Vector Network Analyzer in Wireless Communication, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

exchange.sent: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Vector Network Analyzer in Wireless Communication, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

answer.answer:
### Recommendation focus
The vault supports three directly evidenced VNA opportunities in wireless communication: satellite payload/component testing, network-infrastructure RF design/compliance, and wireless regulatory test labs [11][25][40].
### Recommended first opportunities
| Opportunity | Market demand evidence | Technical measurement need | VNA / R&S evidence | Evidence strength |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Satellite payload and component RF testing | Satellite communication systems support direct broadcast, wireless communications, and remote sensing, and satellite equipment manufacturers face pressure to reduce test time and cost while uplink and downlink beam counts increase [10]. | Satellite payload/component testing covers converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay, and phase measurements [11]. | R&S ZNA is specifically recommended for component-level testing, including converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay, and phase measurements [11]. | This is the strongest direct product-to-application evidence because the passage explicitly names R&S ZNA and the satellite component test role [11]. |
| Network infrastructure RF design, compliance, and small-cell / mmWave contexts | Network densification includes FWA for last mile, mmWave radios, sub-6 small cells, and repeaters [40]. | Network infrastructure testing activities include design and validation, R&D, conformance, calibration, Rx/Tx tests, RF parametric tests, RF component and digital design, and transmitter/receiver/performance tests [40]. | R&S ZNA is listed in the chamber/conformance, small cells, embedded design and power, and RF design and compliance context [40]. | This is direct solution-context evidence because the passage places R&S ZNA inside wireless infrastructure test workflows [40]. |
| Wireless regulatory and certification laboratories | Wireless products require market access approval testing across regulatory compliance, telecom industry certification, and cellular network operator acceptance test categories [96]. | Regulatory test sources list Mobile Satellite Service / Mobile Earth Station items such as RF output power, occupied bandwidth, emission masks, out-of-band emissions, unwanted emissions, carrier-off emissions, and frequency stability [25]. | The regulatory test source groups primary test instruments for wireless regulatory test labs into classes including network analyzer, wireless communication tester, EMI test receiver, signal and spectrum analyzer, vector signal generator, and broadband amplifier [25]. | This is direct instrument-category evidence, but the vault does not identify an exact VNA model or option stack for each regulatory standard [25][27]. |
### Product and option mapping
| Product line | Demand it can connect to | Vault-confirmed option / specification | Why it fits | Evidence | Gap / quotation risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S ZNA | Satellite payload/component RF testing and network-infrastructure RF design/compliance contexts [11][40]. | R&S ZNA covers R&S ZNA26, ZNA43, ZNA50, and ZNA67 with frequency ranges from 10 MHz up to 67 GHz [4]. | R&S ZNA is recommended for satellite component-level testing and is listed in wireless infrastructure RF design/compliance contexts [11][40]. | R&S ZNA supports up to eight independent receivers, four phase-coherent sources, two internal LO sources, and an internal combiner in the satellite testing brochure [38]. | The satellite brochure is an application/solution source and does not replace the latest product datasheet or option/order-number verification [76]. |
| R&S ZNA with measurement options | Satellite component measurements such as group delay and noise figure [11]. | R&S ZNA-K9 is listed for group delay measurements, and R&S ZNA-K30 is listed for noise figure measurement [64]. | The satellite testing passage names group delay and noise figure as component-level roles for R&S ZNA [11]. | Recommended setups are listed for R&S ZNA-K9 group delay measurements and R&S ZNA-K30 noise figure measurement [70]. | The vault does not provide a complete satellite qualification test plan, ESA/ECSS chapter mapping, or customer-specific configuration [76]. |
| R&S ZNA with mmWave and antenna-related access | Satellite components, antennas, and high-frequency infrastructure contexts [11][40]. | R&S ZNA-K8 is listed as mmWave converter support, and R&S ZNA-B26 direct IF access is listed for mmWave converter and antenna measurement systems [61][64]. | The satellite testing passage names antennas and converters among the component-level targets for R&S ZNA [11]. | The ZNA summary states optional rear-panel LO out can support mmWave converters, with up to four converters on a 4-port model and up to two converters on a 2-port model [61]. | The vault does not directly state a complete antenna chamber configuration or measurement uncertainty for R&S ZNA in OTA systems [54][60]. |
| R&S ZNA67EXT | High-frequency VNA system opportunity where 1.0 mm VNA operation up to 110 GHz is needed [31][33]. | R&S ZNA67EXT is a 110 GHz vector network analyzer system based on R&S ZNA67 with external test sets [31][33]. | The product evidence supports high-frequency VNA capability, but the vault does not directly tie R&S ZNA67EXT to a specific wireless communication application [31][33]. | The system consists of one R&S ZNA67 vector network analyzer and up to four external test sets [33]. | The ZNA67EXT specifications apply only when operated as a 1.0 mm vector network analyzer system with the specified system configuration [33]. |
| R&S ZNB3000 / R&S ZNB3044 | Lower-frequency network-analyzer opportunities where 9 kHz to 43.5 GHz or upgrade to 54.0 GHz is sufficient [29][36]. | R&S ZNB3000 base units cover 9 kHz to 4.5 GHz, 20 GHz, 32 GHz, and 43.5 GHz models [29]. | The vault confirms the VNA frequency coverage, but it does not directly connect R&S ZNB3000 or R&S ZNB3044 to wireless communication opportunities [29][36]. | R&S ZNB3044 is a 43.5 GHz VNA model with a frequency upgrade option to 54.0 GHz [36]. | The vault provides product specifications but no direct satellite, infrastructure, or regulatory-lab application mapping for ZNB3000 [29][30]. |
### Scene entry recommendations
| Scene | Recommended combination | Entry point | Unverified items |
|---|---|---|---|
| Satellite payload/component R&D | R&S ZNA with group delay, noise figure, converter, mixer, amplifier, filter, and antenna measurement positioning [11]. | Lead with component-level testing because the satellite testing source explicitly recommends R&S ZNA for converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay, and phase measurements [11]. | The vault does not provide a full satellite payload qualification plan or complete option/order-number list for every satellite test case [39][76]. |
| LEO satellite supply-chain and ground-terminal component ecosystem | R&S ZNA positioning around RF components, antennas, converters, filters, amplifiers, group delay, and noise figure [9][11]. | The Taiwan wireless report identifies LEO ground equipment and user terminal themes around phased-array antennas, Ku/Ka-band, RF front-end, and system integration [9]. | The vault does not directly prove that a specific LEO terminal vendor or Taiwanese supplier uses R&S ZNA [72][80]. |
| Network infrastructure RF design and compliance | R&S ZNA for RF design/compliance and small-cell contexts [40]. | Lead with mmWave radios, sub-6 small cells, repeaters, FWA, and network infrastructure RF component testing workflows [40]. | The vault does not give a detailed ZNA option stack for each network-infrastructure test activity [40]. |
| Wireless regulatory labs | Network analyzer category plus complementary regulatory-lab instruments [25]. | Lead with the fact that network analyzer is listed as a primary instrument class for wireless regulatory test labs [25]. | The vault does not state which network analyzer model, option, standard version, limits, uncertainty, or accreditation scope applies to each regulatory test [27]. |
| Wi-Fi 7 ODM/OEM | Knowledge base does not directly support a VNA-first opportunity for Wi-Fi 7 ODM/OEM [9][52][53]. | The Wi-Fi 7 market evidence covers 320 MHz, 4096-QAM, MLO, 6 GHz, and thermal design, while OTA solution evidence maps Wi-Fi 7 to CMX500, SMBV100B, chambers, and software rather than VNA [9][52][53]. | The vault lacks a passage tying VNA or R&S ZNA to Wi-Fi 7 conformance, production, MLO, 320 MHz, or ODM/OEM test workflows [9][52][53]. |
### Inferences
【推論】Network-infrastructure RF design/compliance is a strong VNA opportunity because the infrastructure source lists R&S ZNA in RF design/compliance contexts and also lists mmWave radios, small cells, repeaters, FWA, and infrastructure test activities [40].
【推論】Regulatory laboratories are an opportunity for the network-analyzer instrument class, but exact R&S VNA configuration must be validated per standard and lab scope because the regulatory source lists network analyzer as a primary instrument class but does not provide model-level configurations [25][27].
### Limitations
The satellite payload/component source is an application brochure and does not replace current R&S product datasheets for option status, order numbers, or detailed configurations [39][76].
The regulatory wireless testing source is limited because it does not provide full standard versions, formal configuration matrices, measurement uncertainties, or complete option stacks for the named solutions [27].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 與既有知識的關係
- 本來源補齊 [[R&S ZNA]] 主系列，與既有 [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 形成關聯：[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer System，量測範圍 10 MHz to 110 GHz；本來源的 [[R&S ZNA67]] 是 67 GHz base VNA 型號，並可透過 [[mmWave converter support]] 與 accessories 延伸應用。
- 本來源與既有 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[R&S FSWX]] 等 spectrum / phase-noise analyzer 頁面在 [[Spectrum analyzer mode]]、[[Phase noise]]、[[Noise figure measurement]] 等功能上有橫向關聯，但本來源屬於 VNA 產品規格，不應與市場或技術背景合併。
- [[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS 與既有其他產品頁的 [[Health and utilization monitoring service]] 有橫向關聯；本來源列出 SNMP、REST JSON、SCPI、device web 等 readout/display protocols。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 讀圖補充
來源包含「【讀圖補充】原文這幾頁沒有文字層」；以下內容可信度低於正文，引用時應標示「[[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]]（讀圖）」。本次輸入的來源摘錄未提供圖片嵌入 wikilink，因此無法在 wiki 頁帶入原圖附件。

- p001（讀圖）：封面可辨識 R&S®ZNA、VECTOR NETWORK ANALYZER、Specifications、Version 24.00、ROHDE&SCHWARZ、Make ideas real、ZNA - Vector Network Analyzer、R&S；背景有類似 Smith chart 的大型圓形網格圖；設備螢幕顯示多個黑底網格曲線圖視窗；前面板可辨識 Port 1、Port 3、Port 2；可辨識數值只有 Version 24.00。
- p044（讀圖）：頁首 Version 24.00, April 2026；圖說為 Test set configuration for R&S®ZNAXx-B501 low power spurious reduction port 1。可辨識 Source、–20 dB、R&S®ZNAXx-B21 source step attenuator 0 dB to 70 dB / 10 dB、R&S®ZNAXx-B161 direct source monitor access、R&S®ZNAXx-B501 low-power spurious reduction 30 dB、R&S®ZNAXx-B31 receiver step attenuators 0 dB to 35 dB / 5 dB、Meas receiver、Ref receiver、Port 1、Source Out、Source In、Meas Out、Meas In、Ref Out、Ref In、Src Mon Out、10 dB。
- p050（讀圖）：頁首 Version 24.00, April 2026；圖說為 Side view of the R&S®ZNA；可辨識尺寸數值 452.1、407.6、131、272.43、272.43、116.1、161.95、56.3、110.5；尺寸數值旁單位無法辨識。
- p059（讀圖）：頁面幾乎空白，無實質內容；可辨識 Version 24.00, April 2026；Rohde & Schwarz R&S®ZNA Vector Network Analyzer；59。

R&S ZNA
[[R&S ZNA]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Network Analyzer 系列，依 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書涵蓋 [[R&S ZNA26]]、[[R&S ZNA43]]、[[R&S ZNA50]]、[[R&S ZNA67]]，頻率範圍從 10 MHz 延伸到最高 67 GHz。

R&S ZNA › Measurement speed
- Measurement speed 測試條件：firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)。
- Acquisition time per point：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog wideband 時 1 µs；30 MHz measurement bandwidth 時 32 ns。
- Linear frequency sweep 條件 201 points、10 GHz center frequency、200 MHz span：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog normal 時 time per sweep < 3.9 ms；sweep cycle time < 4.9 ms。
- IEC/IEEE VXI11 over 1 Gbit/s LAN：201 measurement points、800 MHz start frequency、1 GHz stop frequency、1 MHz measurement bandwidth 的 measurement and data transfer time 為 14 ms / 13 ms；201 measurement points magnitude 的 data transfer time 為 1.7 ms / 0.9 ms。
- Switching time between channels with a maximum of 2001 points：< 2 ms。
- Continuous mode 不需要額外 data transfer time，因為 data transfer 與 measurement 同時進行。

R&S ZNA › 文件依據

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 測試背景
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- 衛星通訊系統需支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，並涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems。
- 衛星系統需要 24/7 operation、multi-decade system longevity 與 satellite life cycle 期間的 quality of service。
- 現代衛星系統需相容 existing cellular networks 與 emerging wireless technologies。
- 衛星設備製造商面臨 test time / cost 降低需求，同時 uplink beams 與 downlink beams 總數增加。
- 一個 uplink digital data stream 可能對應 multiple downlink streams，因此測試方案需 straightforward、fast、reproducible，且具備 high measurement performance 與 repeatability。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單 › TTC 毫米波測試量能線索
[[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]（來源標示 111年08月）介紹[[電信技術中心]]毫米波頻段測試量能：

- 5G FR2 毫米波天線縮距量測場 CATR。
- 來源稱該 chamber 依據 3GPP 技術規範標準，已通過 TAF 認證。
- 可支援主波發射頻段 3–40 GHz。
- 不必要發射至 90 GHz。
- 可量測 TRP、TIS、EVM。
- Quiet Zone 可達 90 cm。

同一來源另描述[[電信技術中心]]提供電信設備審驗認證服務，並協助研擬電信技術標準規範。

5G FR2 RF conformance testing
[[5G FR2 RF conformance testing]] 是針對 5G NR UE 在 [[NR FR2]] / mmWave 頻段的 RF / RRM conformance 測試主題；[[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]]（檔名日期 2020-11-02）以 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]] / [[R&S TS8980FTA]] series customer presentation 形式整理 3GPP 規格、FR2 bands、OTA spatial metrics、chamber portfolio、system configurations 與 2021 roadmap。

5G FR2 RF conformance testing › OTA / spatial test metrics
本來源以 [[FR2 OTA spatial test metrics]] 方式整理 FR2 conformance 的 power / sensitivity / beam peak 量測語彙。

依 Slide 10：

- Scan / Max Power：[[EIRP]] CDF。
- 6.2.1 Max Tx Power：[[TRP]] / [[EIRP]] @ TX-BP。
- 6.3.1 Min Tx Power：[[EIRP]] @ TX-BP。
- 6.3.2 Off Power：[[TRP]] @ TX-BP。
- 6.4.2.2 EVM：@ TX-BP。
- 6.5.2 SEM：[[TRP]] @ BP。
- 6.5.3.2.4 ACLR：[[TRP]] / [[EIRP]] @ BP。
- TX Spurious Emissions：[[TRP]] @ BP。
- Scan / Throughput Scan：[[EIS]] CDF。
- 7.3 Reference Sensitivity, EIS：@ RX-BP。
- 7.4 Max Input Level：@ RX-BP。
- 7.5 ACS：@ RX-BP。
- 7.6.1 In-Band Blocking：@ RX-BP。
- 7.9 Rx Spurious Emissions：[[TRP]] @ RX-BP。

Slide note：

- Chapter 6 的 beam peak 是 Tx beam peak，即 100%-tile of EIRP CDF = strongest beam。
- Chapter 7 的 beam peak 是 Rx beam peak，即 0%-tile of EIS CDF = strongest beam；來源註明 0%-tile is where the most sensitive link was found。

5G FR2 RF conformance testing › Frequency range baseline
[[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] 補入 FR1 / FR2 的基本 range 定義：

| Frequency range | Range | Release 標示 | 來源 |
|---|---:|---|---|
| [[NR FR1]] | 410 MHz to 7125 MHz | Release 15 | [[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] |
| [[NR FR2]] / [[FR2-1]] | 24.25 GHz to 52.6 GHz | Release 15 | [[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] |
| [[FR2-2]] | 52.6 GHz to 71 GHz | Release 17 | [[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] |

判斷：這補充本頁的 FR2 測試背景，但不改寫 2020 presentation 的 band table 與 roadmap 內容；[[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] 未提供 conformance test procedure、limits 或 GCF/PTCRB validation status。

5G NTN validation and testing › 涉及的產品與能力口徑
[[Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing]] 明示 [[Gatehouse Satcom]] gains access to the [[R&S CMX500]] platform，作為 joint effort 的一部分。

但此來源是 PR，不是 [[R&S CMX500]] formal specifications；因此：

- 可以說：[[R&S CMX500]] 是本合作中被明示使用的平台。
- 可以說：合作方向包含 advanced orbit and channel emulation capabilities for NTN use cases。
- 不可說：本來源證明某個 [[R&S CMX500]] option code、hardware configuration、frequency band、satellite orbit、channel model 或 3GPP release 已正式支援。
- 正式配置仍需回 [[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]]、[[CMX_Configuration_Guide_NR-NTN]]、[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]。

[[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]] 明示 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[R&S SMBV100B]] 與 [[MediaTek]] NTN-NR device as DUT 共同用於 demo setup：

- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] radio communication tester simulate the satellite base station。
- [[R&S SMBV100B]] vector signal generator simulate different satellite constellations with its integrated GNSS option。
- [[R&S CMX500]] operate in interactive callbox mode，讓 users trigger voice calls alongside RF-related measurements。

[[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]] 明示 [[Viasat NB-NTN IoT test plan]] based on [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 versatile solution designed for testing various NTN technologies，包括 [[NR-NTN]] 與 [[NB-NTN]]。
- PR 稱 single instrument covers R&D through certification and carrier acceptance tests，並提供 reliable and repeatable results。
- 此為 PR / solution-level claim；正式 configuration、license stack、measurement uncertainty、supported bands、NB-NTN test cases 與 carrier acceptance scope 未在來源中列出。

5G NTN validation and testing › 來源中的測試目標
依 [[Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing]]，[[Gatehouse Satcom]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的合作目標包含：

- strengthen validation and testing of [[5G IoT-NTN]] and [[NR-NTN]] technologies。
- 在市場從 specification work 走向 real-world implementation 時，改善 validation 方法。
- 在 realistic and controlled laboratory conditions 下測試 5G NTN technologies。
- further develop advanced orbit and channel emulation capabilities for NTN use cases。
- 支援更準確的 satellite radio channel modelling。
- 更 realistic testing of 5G NTN behavior across different scenarios。
- 支援 faster validation cycles、earlier identification of system-level issues 與 stronger test conditions。
- reduce technical uncertainty and accelerate time to market for the broader NTN ecosystem。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]]，MWC 2024 展示目標包含：

- demonstrate a [[5G Non-Terrestrial Network]] [[New Radio]] connection based on latest [[3GPP Release 17]] specifications。
- emulate a [[Low Earth Orbit]] satellite access node。
- showcase 5G technology providing connectivity in areas without terrestrial coverage。
- 展示 basic mobile services，例如 voice、messaging 與 low data rate services，面向 maritime、aeronautical 與 rural applications。
- 在 interactive callbox mode 中讓 users trigger voice calls alongside RF-related measurements。
- 評估 future NTN-NR devices powered by [[MediaTek]] NTN test platform 在不同 conditions 下的 performance and reliability。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]]，[[Viasat]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 NB-NTN IoT test plan 目標包含：

5G NTN validation and testing › 來源中的測試目標
- boost testing for [[Narrowband Non-terrestrial Networks]]（[[NB-NTN]]）[[IoT]] devices connecting via satellite。
- thoroughly validate devices and confirm interoperability with [[Viasat]] network。
- help ensure uninterrupted connectivity for satellite-based [[IoT]] applications。
- ensure chipsets、modules and devices interoperate seamlessly with [[Viasat]] satellite network。
- comply with [[3GPP Release 17]] standards。
- uphold quality、performance and reliability for [[Viasat]] connectivity services in areas without terrestrial network coverage。
- certification test plan entails protocol、performance and RF test scenarios。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

NTN test and measurement aspects
[[NTN test and measurement aspects]] 是 [[5G-NTN-takes-flight-A-deep-dive_wp_en_3673-3210-52_v0100]] 對 NTN device、satellite、SAN、payload、phased array antenna、network 與 production testing 的總覽，涵蓋 RF、protocol、RRM、LBS、conformance、OTA、field testing 與 software-assisted testing。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[EN 303 981]] 測試描述為 antenna characterizations 的 radiated measurement，列出 antenna beam pointing、off/on-axis spurious radiation、carrier suppression / cessation、blocking performance、adjacent signal selectivity、image frequency rejection、WBES location / identification、control and monitoring functions、receive antenna off-axis gain pattern，並連到 [[R&S SMBV100B]]、[[R&S ELEKTRA]]、[[R&S TS8996]]。
- 來源列出 FCC CFR47 §25 Mobile Satellite Service / Mobile Earth Station test items：RF output power、occupied bandwidth、emission mask within 25% of authorized BW、out of band emissions、additional unwanted emission 1559–1610 MHz、carrier-off state emissions 1559–1610 MHz、frequency stability，並提到 ANSI C63.26 / FCC KDBs。
- 最後來源把 primary test instruments for wireless regulatory test labs 分成 wireless communication tester、EMI test receiver、signal & spectrum analyzer、network analyzer、vector signal generator、broadband amplifier 等類別。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源指出 smartphone Art 3.3g / [[Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019-320]] / E112 是沒有 ETSI EN standard 的 regulatory compliance requirement；當沒有 EN standard available 時需 Notified body involved，並稱 [[R&S TS-LBS]] 是 first test solution available to perform the necessary LBS compliance tests。
- [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]部分列出 [[47 CFR]]、[[ANSI C63.26]]、[[ANSI C63.10]]、[[IEEE Std 1528-2013]]、[[C63.19]] 等測試依據，並列出 licensed cellular CFR47 test items：RF power output、modulation characteristics、occupied bandwidth、band edge、spurious emissions、frequency stability、peak to average ratio、field strength of spurious radiation。
- 來源以 [[ITU-R SM.329-12]] 與 [[47 CFR §2.1057]] 對照 CE RED / FCC 的 frequency range：5G NR FR1 的 CE RED 30 MHz–26 GHz、FCC 9 kHz–40 GHz；5G NR FR2 的 CE RED 30 MHz–90 GHz、FCC 9 kHz–200 GHz；並提到 [[R&S FSV3000]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S ESW]]。
- [[NTN 裝置法規測試]]部分把 NTN device implementation 分成 proprietary、3GPP < R16、3GPP R17 NTN-IoT、reuse spectrum assets / 3GPP unmodified UE 等路徑，例子包含 iPhone 14 / Globalstar、Qualcomm / Iridium、MTK / Bullitt / Skylo、AT&T / AST Space Mobile、T-Mobile / Starlink、Optus / Lynk。
- 來源列出衛星 / NTN 相關 EN standards：[[EN 301 441]]、[[EN 301 442]]、[[EN 301 444]]、[[EN 301 681]]、[[EN 302 574]]、[[EN 303 981]]，並將 iPhone14、Bullitt defy satellite link、StarLink Dish 作為 DoC / market product examples。
- 來源將 [[EN 301 681]] 測試偏向 conducted measurement，列出 spectrum analyzer、signal generator、BER measure / system emulator / mobile radio tester 等 required instruments，並明示 latest [[R&S CMW500]] software can support 3GPP R17 NB-NTN signalling。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 Rohde & Schwarz application brochure《Satellite payload and components testing》，文件代碼 `PD 5215.2120.92`，Version 02.00，文件日期標示 `September 2022 (ch)`，主題是使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器測試 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、transponders、modules 與 components。

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。

5G NR conducted base station receiver tests › Chapter 7 test cases
依 [[GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests]]（12.2020），GFM314 覆蓋下列 [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] chapter 7 receiver tests：

| Test case | 名稱 | 來源摘要 |
|---|---|---|
| 7.2 | Reference Sensitivity Level | 測量 receiver 在 reference sensitivity power level `PREFSENS` 下是否滿足 reference measurement channel throughput requirement。 |
| 7.3 | Dynamic Range | 測量 receiver 在 received channel bandwidth 內存在 [[AWGN]] interferer 時接收 wanted signal 的能力。 |
| 7.4.1 | Adjacent Channel Selectivity（ACS） | 測量 receiver 在相鄰通道 5G NR interferer 存在時接收 assigned channel wanted signal 的能力。 |
| 7.4.2a | In-band Blocking: General | 以 NR interferer center frequency 1 MHz step size 掃描，測量 in-band blocking。 |
| 7.4.2b | In-band Blocking: Narrow-band blocking | 類似 ACS，但 interfering signal 只包含 1 resource block。 |
| 7.5 | Out-of-band Blocking | 以 CW interferer 進行 out-of-band blocking 掃頻測試。 |
| 7.6 | Receiver Spurious Emissions | 測量 receiver 產生或放大的 emissions 出現在 BS receiver antenna connector 的功率。 |
| 7.7 | Receiver Intermodulation | 測量 two interfering signals（CW + QPSK NR signal）造成 intermodulation effect 時 receiver 接收 wanted signal 的能力。 |
| 7.8 | In-channel selectivity | 測量較高 PSD interferer 存在下，receiver 在 assigned RB locations 接收 wanted signal 的能力。 |

衛星酬載與元件測試
[[衛星酬載與元件測試]]是針對 satellite transponders、payload subsystems、modules 與 RF / digital components 的設計、開發、驗證與 qualification 測試集合，來源以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器方案為主。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › Payload 架構層級
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 將 satellite payload 技術演進描述為：

- Bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads。
- Digital regenerative payloads。

Bent-pipe satellite payload channel 的 high-level components 包含：

- uplink antenna
- low noise amplifier
- filter
- frequency converter
- filter
- high power amplifier
- filter
- downlink antenna
- local oscillator

Regenerative payload channel 在上述鏈路中加入：

- digital demodulator
- baseband processing and switching
- digital modulator

來源稱 regenerative payloads 可提升 system capacity 與 flexibility，但會增加 testing complexity。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 使用限制
- 本概念頁來自 2022 年 application brochure，屬 application / solution 說明，不是最新產品規格書。
- 不可用本頁取代 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S ZNA]] 等產品 datasheet 的 option、order number 或規格條件。
- 來源沒有給出完整 satellite payload qualification test plan、標準版本、ESA / ECSS 章節或客戶案例。

無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單 › 台灣 NCC 認證流程線索
[[無線通訊認證實驗室]]列出台灣 [[NCC]] 認證流程：

1. 準備：文件、樣品、電路圖、天線規格。
2. 提交初審：[[RCB]] 核驗機構檢查材料。
3. 實驗室測試：[[TAF]] 認可實驗室進行 RF / EMC 測試，來源標示 3–4 週。
4. 審核與核發：報告審查、證書核發，來源標示證書 5 年有效。

限制：來源未提供 NCC 法規名稱、公告日期、產品類別、RCB 名單、TAF 認可範圍或正式流程文件，因此只能作為簡報層級線索。

5G FR2 RF conformance testing › Chamber / system portfolio
依 [[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]] Slide 16：

- [[WPTC]]：FR2 UE R&D / 20 cm QZ / cost efficient / can be rack-integrated。
- [[ATS1000]]：FR2 production & R&D / flexible test capability / can be rack-integrated。
- [[ATS800R]]：FR2 UE R&D / 20 cm QZ / cost efficient / can be rack-integrated。
- [[R&S ATS1800C]]：FR2 UE conformance & CTIA / 30 cm QZ / RF, RRM, PCT。
- [[CMQ200]] / [[CMQ500]]：FR2 chip and antenna R&D / fast, accurate, compact / 3-D thermal testing。

Slide 17 區分：

- DFF for Whitebox testing。
- IFF for Blackbox testing。
- 來源說 both systems use ATS form factor，但 implementation details 需要不同 chamber modifications，因此 CATR 版本使用 `c`。

5G FR2 RF conformance testing › TS8980 FR2 system configurations
依 [[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]]：

- Slide 22 的 FR2 system configuration elements 包含 [[R&S CMW500]] + [[R&S CMX500]] with IF boards & RRHs、anechoic chamber [[R&S ATS1800C]]、RF connection box、[[R&S CMX-RF42]]、RRHs。
- Slide 23 列出 four system configurations：Callbox SISO、Callbox MIMO、Conformance Basic、Conformance Advanced；但圖像內容未完整 OCR。
- Slide 24 將 [[R&S TS8980FTA-M1]] 描述為 standalone test system for FR2，for 3GPP-based RF / RRM conformance – GCF TP298。
- Slide 25 將 `TS8980FTA-3AM1` / `TS8980-3AM1` 描述為 FR2 + FR1/LTE combo test system，並指出 `TS8980-M1` 有 FTA 或 PRE two flavours。
- Slide 26 表示 [[R&S TS8980FTA-3]] 可經 upgrade path 擴充到 `TS8980FTA-3AM1`，從 conducted Sub6 / LTE / legacy 擴展到 mmW。

5G FR2 RF conformance testing › 使用限制
- 本頁主要依 2020-11-02 company restricted customer presentation 的 lossy markdown 轉檔整理，非正式 3GPP 標準本文、R&S datasheet、GCF / PTCRB official validation record 或現行 product support matrix。
- [[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] 提供的是 Knowledge 層級 frequency range / bandwidth 摘要，不提供 FR2 conformance test case procedure 或 validation status。
- 來源內多張投影片是圖片 placeholder，若要確認 system configuration、certification selection、roadmap milestone 或 option detail，需回查原始 PPTX。
- 2021 roadmap 是 presentation 時點的規劃，不可推論後續已完成或仍支援。
- FR2 band table、n262、52–71 GHz study 與 channel bandwidth / SCS discussion 是 2020 年 10 月 RAN4 / RAN5 status，不可視為最新 3GPP 狀態。
- `GCF TP298` 來源未展開，需另查 GCF / R&S 文件。
- [[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] 的 FR2 Release 17 band table 未被 raw 擷取，尚不能用它替換本頁 2020 band table。

5G NTN validation and testing › 使用限制
- 本頁只整理 PR 層級合作、測試方法、certification test plan 與展示語境，不是產品規格、標準規格或 conformance test plan。
- Gatehouse Satcom 來源未標示 published date、PR 編號或 formal version。
- Rohde & Schwarz / MediaTek MWC 2024 來源未標示 published date、PR 編號或 formal version。
- Rohde & Schwarz / Viasat 來源未標示 published date、test plan version、document number、test case list 或 certification body。
- 來源未列 supported test cases、frequency bands、channel models、orbit emulation limits、payload types、UE categories、satellite operators 或 measurement accuracy。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]] 未提供 MediaTek NTN-NR device 型號、R&S CMX500 OBT configuration、SMBV100B GNSS option code 或 physical test setup。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]] 未提供 [[Viasat]] satellite network technical profile、NB-NTN device list、CMX500 option stack 或 first test results data。
- future [[6G NTN testing and validation]] 只可視為 PR ambition；不可推論已有產品或測試能力。

5G NTN validation and testing
[[5G NTN validation and testing]] 是針對 [[5G Non-Terrestrial Networks]]、[[5G IoT-NTN]]、[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]] 與 satellite connectivity devices，在 realistic and controlled laboratory conditions 下驗證 satellite connectivity behavior、radio channel modelling、orbit / channel emulation、protocol / performance / RF scenarios 與 system-level behavior 的測試活動。[[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]] 補充一個 [[MWC Barcelona 2024]] 展示例子：以 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[R&S SMBV100B]] 與 [[MediaTek]] NTN-NR device as DUT 展示基於 [[3GPP Release 17]] specifications 的 live [[5G NTN-NR]] connection。[[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]] 則補入 [[Viasat]] / [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 [[NB-NTN]] [[IoT]] certification test plan 語境，焦點是 device validation、interoperability with [[Viasat]] satellite network 與 [[3GPP Release 17]] compliance。

5G NTN validation and testing › 軌道與標準化語境
[[Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing]] 的標題強調 [[GEO]] and [[LEO]] NTN validation and testing；正文 quote 進一步提到 [[GEO]]、[[MEO]] and [[LEO]] satellite services。

[[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]] 只明示 emulating a [[Low Earth Orbit]] satellite access node，並將展示連結到 latest [[3GPP Release 17]] specifications。

[[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]] 明示 [[3GPP Release 17]] standards 與 [[Viasat]] satellite network interoperability，但未說明 orbit、frequency bands、payload type 或 gateway architecture。

Gatehouse Satcom 來源也將 NTN 產業背景描述為 converges on standardized, [[3GPP]] based solutions，並提到 today’s [[5G NTN]] rollout 與 future [[6G NTN testing and validation]]。

5G NTN validation and testing › 與既有 NTN discovery / configuration 的關係
- [[NTN signaling customer discovery]]：用問卷釐清 service offering、test layer、release、satellite architecture、UE、QoS、mobility 與 constellation deployment；屬於需求蒐集。
- [[R&S NTN signaling solutions]]：目前主要由 customer questionnaire 支撐，代表 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 NTN signaling solution discovery 語境。
- [[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]]：整理 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 NR-NTN application-specific configuration guide，包含 S/L-band golden callbox、fading、mobility、Ku/Ka-band、preconformance 與 xLAPI automation。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]]：補充 MWC 2024 demo / PR 語境，展示 Rel.17 [[5G NTN-NR]] connection、LEO access node emulation、voice calls 與 RF-related measurements。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]]：補充 MWC Barcelona 2026 前後的 partner-specific [[NB-NTN]] / [[NB-IoT]] IoT device certification test plan 語境，涵蓋 protocol、performance 與 RF test scenarios。
- 本頁的 PR 來源補充的是 ecosystem collaboration、validation methodology、demo / certification context，不取代需求問卷、configuration guide 或 formal specifications。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Signal generation、analysis 與 SpaceNexus
來源描述：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可配備 fading emulator，支援 TDL / CDL、custom fading profile、Doppler、delay、path loss，以及 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading。
- [[R&S SpaceNexus]] 可設定 satellite constellation、UE position / mobility、time-variant Doppler、time-variant propagation delay、path loss、weather-induced attenuation，並 remote configure SMW200A。
- [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSWX]] 支援 satellite payload testing、EVM、ACLR、group delay、DVB-S2X analysis、phase-coherent multichannel measurement。
- [[R&S PVT360A]] 被描述為 potential satellite production testing platform，整合 vector signal generator 與 vector spectrum analyzer。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Mobile network testing（MNT）
來源指出 [[Mobile network testing]] 可擴展至 NTN：

- passive testing：scanner 監測 downlink spectrum，不建立連線。
- active testing：test UE / QualiPoc Android 做 connected mode / E2E QoS / QoE testing。
- NTN MNT metrics 包含 RSRP、RSRQ、RS-SINR、RSSI、spectrum clearance、RTT、packet loss、BLER、throughput、mobility、random access success、SIB decoding、SMS / voice / video QoE。
- DTC LEO 與 Skylo IoT-NTN drive test examples 被作為 MNT early scenarios。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Conformance / certification testing
來源描述 certification ecosystem 包含 certification organization、neutral test house、test equipment vendor、network operator / equipment vendor。

- NTN NB-IoT certification program 已於 late 2024 launched，聚焦 n255 / n256。
- conformance tests 在 [[GCF]] [[WI-555]] 與 [[PTCRB]] [[RFT 555]] umbrella 下定義。
- 來源說 GCF WI-555 描述 124 個 NTN conformance testing 相關 test cases。
- early 2026 狀態：IoT_NTN test cases 約 174；GSO RF TRX / Performance / RRM 為 58 / 6 / 46，NGSO RF TRX / Performance / RRM 為 56 / 8 / 0。
- 目前狀態另列 NR-NTN testing 約 RRM 93、RF 38、protocol 22 test cases。
- 2025 年 GCF 擴展 certification program，納入 NR-NTN 與 DTC certification testing。

NTN test and measurement aspects › UE NTN testing
UE NTN testing categories：

- RF testing。
- protocol testing。
- performance testing。
- carrier acceptance testing。
- interoperability testing。

相關規格：

- [[TS 38.101-5]]：satellite NR UE RF and performance requirements。
- [[TS 38.521-5]]：NR UE satellite access RF / performance conformance procedures。
- [[TS 38.523]]：protocol conformance。
- [[TS 38.533]]：RRM conformance。
- [[TS 38.133]]：RRM requirements。

目前 RF tests 多聚焦 FR1；來源預期未來會擴展到 FR2、Ka-band、Ku-band 與 moving satellite conditions。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

### Recommendation focus
The vault supports three directly evidenced VNA opportunities in wireless communication: satellite payload/component testing, network-infrastructure RF design/compliance, and wireless regulatory test labs [11][25][40].
### Recommended first opportunities
| Opportunity | Market demand evidence | Technical measurement need | VNA / R&S evidence | Evidence strength |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Satellite payload and component RF testing | Satellite communication systems support direct broadcast, wireless communications, and remote sensing, and satellite equipment manufacturers face pressure to reduce test time and cost while uplink and downlink beam counts increase [10]. | Satellite payload/component testing covers converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay, and phase measurements [11]. | R&S ZNA is specifically recommended for component-level testing, including converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay, and phase measurements [11]. | This is the strongest direct product-to-application evidence because the passage explicitly names R&S ZNA and the satellite component test role [11]. |
| Network infrastructure RF design, compliance, and small-cell / mmWave contexts | Network densification includes FWA for last mile, mmWave radios, sub-6 small cells, and repeaters [40]. | Network infrastructure testing activities include design and validation, R&D, conformance, calibration, Rx/Tx tests, RF parametric tests, RF component and digital design, and transmitter/receiver/performance tests [40]. | R&S ZNA is listed in the chamber/conformance, small cells, embedded design and power, and RF design and compliance context [40]. | This is direct solution-context evidence because the passage places R&S ZNA inside wireless infrastructure test workflows [40]. |
| Wireless regulatory and certification laboratories | Wireless products require market access approval testing across regulatory compliance, telecom industry certification, and cellular network operator acceptance test categories [96]. | Regulatory test sources list Mobile Satellite Service / Mobile Earth Station items such as RF output power, occupied bandwidth, emission masks, out-of-band emissions, unwanted emissions, carrier-off emissions, and frequency stability [25]. | The regulatory test source groups primary test instruments for wireless regulatory test labs into classes including network analyzer, wireless communication tester, EMI test receiver, signal and spectrum analyzer, vector signal generator, and broadband amplifier [25]. | This is direct instrument-category evidence, but the vault does not identify an exact VNA model or option stack for each regulatory standard [25][27]. |
### Product and option mapping
| Product line | Demand it can connect to | Vault-confirmed option / specification | Why it fits | Evidence | Gap / quotation risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S ZNA | Satellite payload/component RF testing and network-infrastructure RF design/compliance contexts [11][40]. | R&S ZNA covers R&S ZNA26, ZNA43, ZNA50, and ZNA67 with frequency ranges from 10 MHz up to 67 GHz [4]. | R&S ZNA is recommended for satellite component-level testing and is listed in wireless infrastructure RF design/compliance contexts [11][40]. | R&S ZNA supports up to eight independent receivers, four phase-coherent sources, two internal LO sources, and an internal combiner in the satellite testing brochure [38]. | The satellite brochure is an application/solution source and does not replace the latest product datasheet or option/order-number verification [76]. |
| R&S ZNA with measurement options | Satellite component measurements such as group delay and noise figure [11]. | R&S ZNA-K9 is listed for group delay measurements, and R&S ZNA-K30 is listed for noise figure measurement [64]. | The satellite testing passage names group delay and noise figure as component-level roles for R&S ZNA [11]. | Recommended setups are listed for R&S ZNA-K9 group delay measurements and R&S ZNA-K30 noise figure measurement [70]. | The vault does not provide a complete satellite qualification test plan, ESA/ECSS chapter mapping, or customer-specific configuration [76]. |
| R&S ZNA with mmWave and antenna-related access | Satellite components, antennas, and high-frequency infrastructure contexts [11][40]. | R&S ZNA-K8 is listed as mmWave converter support, and R&S ZNA-B26 direct IF access is listed for mmWave converter and antenna measurement systems [61][64]. | The satellite testing passage names antennas and converters among the component-level targets for R&S ZNA [11]. | The ZNA summary states optional rear-panel LO out can support mmWave converters, with up to four converters on a 4-port model and up to two converters on a 2-port model [61]. | The vault does not directly state a complete antenna chamber configuration or measurement uncertainty for R&S ZNA in OTA systems [54][60]. |
| R&S ZNA67EXT | High-frequency VNA system opportunity where 1.0 mm VNA operation up to 110 GHz is needed [31][33]. | R&S ZNA67EXT is a 110 GHz vector network analyzer system based on R&S ZNA67 with external test sets [31][33]. | The product evidence supports high-frequency VNA capability, but the vault does not directly tie R&S ZNA67EXT to a specific wireless communication application [31][33]. | The system consists of one R&S ZNA67 vector network analyzer and up to four external test sets [33]. | The ZNA67EXT specifications apply only when operated as a 1.0 mm vector network analyzer system with the specified system configuration [33]. |
| R&S ZNB3000 / R&S ZNB3044 | Lower-frequency network-analyzer opportunities where 9 kHz to 43.5 GHz or upgrade to 54.0 GHz is sufficient [29][36]. | R&S ZNB3000 base units cover 9 kHz to 4.5 GHz, 20 GHz, 32 GHz, and 43.5 GHz models [29]. | The vault confirms the VNA frequency coverage, but it does not directly connect R&S ZNB3000 or R&S ZNB3044 to wireless communication opportunities [29][36]. | R&S ZNB3044 is a 43.5 GHz VNA model with a frequency upgrade option to 54.0 GHz [36]. | The vault provides product specifications but no direct satellite, infrastructure, or regulatory-lab application mapping for ZNB3000 [29][30]. |
### Scene entry recommendations
| Scene | Recommended combination | Entry point | Unverified items |
|---|---|---|---|
| Satellite payload/component R&D | R&S ZNA with group delay, noise figure, converter, mixer, amplifier, filter, and antenna measurement positioning [11]. | Lead with component-level testing because the satellite testing source explicitly recommends R&S ZNA for converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay, and phase measurements [11]. | The vault does not provide a full satellite payload qualification plan or complete option/order-number list for every satellite test case [39][76]. |
| LEO satellite supply-chain and ground-terminal component ecosystem | R&S ZNA positioning around RF components, antennas, converters, filters, amplifiers, group delay, and noise figure [9][11]. | The Taiwan wireless report identifies LEO ground equipment and user terminal themes around phased-array antennas, Ku/Ka-band, RF front-end, and system integration [9]. | The vault does not directly prove that a specific LEO terminal vendor or Taiwanese supplier uses R&S ZNA [72][80]. |
| Network infrastructure RF design and compliance | R&S ZNA for RF design/compliance and small-cell contexts [40]. | Lead with mmWave radios, sub-6 small cells, repeaters, FWA, and network infrastructure RF component testing workflows [40]. | The vault does not give a detailed ZNA option stack for each network-infrastructure test activity [40]. |
| Wireless regulatory labs | Network analyzer category plus complementary regulatory-lab instruments [25]. | Lead with the fact that network analyzer is listed as a primary instrument class for wireless regulatory test labs [25]. | The vault does not state which network analyzer model, option, standard version, limits, uncertainty, or accreditation scope applies to each regulatory test [27]. |
| Wi-Fi 7 ODM/OEM | Knowledge base does not directly support a VNA-first opportunity for Wi-Fi 7 ODM/OEM [9][52][53]. | The Wi-Fi 7 market evidence covers 320 MHz, 4096-QAM, MLO, 6 GHz, and thermal design, while OTA solution evidence maps Wi-Fi 7 to CMX500, SMBV100B, chambers, and software rather than VNA [9][52][53]. | The vault lacks a passage tying VNA or R&S ZNA to Wi-Fi 7 conformance, production, MLO, 320 MHz, or ODM/OEM test workflows [9][52][53]. |
### Inferences
【推論】Network-infrastructure RF design/compliance is a strong VNA opportunity because the infrastructure source lists R&S ZNA in RF design/compliance contexts and also lists mmWave radios, small cells, repeaters, FWA, and infrastructure test activities [40].
【推論】Regulatory laboratories are an opportunity for the network-analyzer instrument class, but exact R&S VNA configuration must be validated per standard and lab scope because the regulatory source lists network analyzer as a primary instrument class but does not provide model-level configurations [25][27].
### Limitations
The satellite payload/component source is an application brochure and does not replace current R&S product datasheets for option status, order numbers, or detailed configurations [39][76].
The regulatory wireless testing source is limited because it does not provide full standard versions, formal configuration matrices, measurement uncertainties, or complete option stacks for the named solutions [27].

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 測試背景
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- 衛星通訊系統需支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，並涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems。
- 衛星系統需要 24/7 operation、multi-decade system longevity 與 satellite life cycle 期間的 quality of service。
- 現代衛星系統需相容 existing cellular networks 與 emerging wireless technologies。
- 衛星設備製造商面臨 test time / cost 降低需求，同時 uplink beams 與 downlink beams 總數增加。
- 一個 uplink digital data stream 可能對應 multiple downlink streams，因此測試方案需 straightforward、fast、reproducible，且具備 high measurement performance 與 repeatability。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[EN 303 981]] 測試描述為 antenna characterizations 的 radiated measurement，列出 antenna beam pointing、off/on-axis spurious radiation、carrier suppression / cessation、blocking performance、adjacent signal selectivity、image frequency rejection、WBES location / identification、control and monitoring functions、receive antenna off-axis gain pattern，並連到 [[R&S SMBV100B]]、[[R&S ELEKTRA]]、[[R&S TS8996]]。
- 來源列出 FCC CFR47 §25 Mobile Satellite Service / Mobile Earth Station test items：RF output power、occupied bandwidth、emission mask within 25% of authorized BW、out of band emissions、additional unwanted emission 1559–1610 MHz、carrier-off state emissions 1559–1610 MHz、frequency stability，並提到 ANSI C63.26 / FCC KDBs。
- 最後來源把 primary test instruments for wireless regulatory test labs 分成 wireless communication tester、EMI test receiver、signal & spectrum analyzer、network analyzer、vector signal generator、broadband amplifier 等類別。

- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。

- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 測試背景
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- 衛星通訊系統需支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，並涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems。
- 衛星系統需要 24/7 operation、multi-decade system longevity 與 satellite life cycle 期間的 quality of service。
- 現代衛星系統需相容 existing cellular networks 與 emerging wireless technologies。
- 衛星設備製造商面臨 test time / cost 降低需求，同時 uplink beams 與 downlink beams 總數增加。
- 一個 uplink digital data stream 可能對應 multiple downlink streams，因此測試方案需 straightforward、fast、reproducible，且具備 high measurement performance 與 repeatability。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單 › TTC 毫米波測試量能線索
[[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]（來源標示 111年08月）介紹[[電信技術中心]]毫米波頻段測試量能：

- 5G FR2 毫米波天線縮距量測場 CATR。
- 來源稱該 chamber 依據 3GPP 技術規範標準，已通過 TAF 認證。
- 可支援主波發射頻段 3–40 GHz。
- 不必要發射至 90 GHz。
- 可量測 TRP、TIS、EVM。
- Quiet Zone 可達 90 cm。

同一來源另描述[[電信技術中心]]提供電信設備審驗認證服務，並協助研擬電信技術標準規範。

5G FR2 RF conformance testing
[[5G FR2 RF conformance testing]] 是針對 5G NR UE 在 [[NR FR2]] / mmWave 頻段的 RF / RRM conformance 測試主題；[[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]]（檔名日期 2020-11-02）以 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]] / [[R&S TS8980FTA]] series customer presentation 形式整理 3GPP 規格、FR2 bands、OTA spatial metrics、chamber portfolio、system configurations 與 2021 roadmap。

5G FR2 RF conformance testing › OTA / spatial test metrics
本來源以 [[FR2 OTA spatial test metrics]] 方式整理 FR2 conformance 的 power / sensitivity / beam peak 量測語彙。

依 Slide 10：

- Scan / Max Power：[[EIRP]] CDF。
- 6.2.1 Max Tx Power：[[TRP]] / [[EIRP]] @ TX-BP。
- 6.3.1 Min Tx Power：[[EIRP]] @ TX-BP。
- 6.3.2 Off Power：[[TRP]] @ TX-BP。
- 6.4.2.2 EVM：@ TX-BP。
- 6.5.2 SEM：[[TRP]] @ BP。
- 6.5.3.2.4 ACLR：[[TRP]] / [[EIRP]] @ BP。
- TX Spurious Emissions：[[TRP]] @ BP。
- Scan / Throughput Scan：[[EIS]] CDF。
- 7.3 Reference Sensitivity, EIS：@ RX-BP。
- 7.4 Max Input Level：@ RX-BP。
- 7.5 ACS：@ RX-BP。
- 7.6.1 In-Band Blocking：@ RX-BP。
- 7.9 Rx Spurious Emissions：[[TRP]] @ RX-BP。

Slide note：

- Chapter 6 的 beam peak 是 Tx beam peak，即 100%-tile of EIRP CDF = strongest beam。
- Chapter 7 的 beam peak 是 Rx beam peak，即 0%-tile of EIS CDF = strongest beam；來源註明 0%-tile is where the most sensitive link was found。

5G FR2 RF conformance testing › Frequency range baseline
[[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] 補入 FR1 / FR2 的基本 range 定義：

| Frequency range | Range | Release 標示 | 來源 |
|---|---:|---|---|
| [[NR FR1]] | 410 MHz to 7125 MHz | Release 15 | [[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] |
| [[NR FR2]] / [[FR2-1]] | 24.25 GHz to 52.6 GHz | Release 15 | [[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] |
| [[FR2-2]] | 52.6 GHz to 71 GHz | Release 17 | [[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] |

判斷：這補充本頁的 FR2 測試背景，但不改寫 2020 presentation 的 band table 與 roadmap 內容；[[Frequency Ranges, Bands and Bandwidth]] 未提供 conformance test procedure、limits 或 GCF/PTCRB validation status。

5G NTN validation and testing › 涉及的產品與能力口徑
[[Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing]] 明示 [[Gatehouse Satcom]] gains access to the [[R&S CMX500]] platform，作為 joint effort 的一部分。

但此來源是 PR，不是 [[R&S CMX500]] formal specifications；因此：

- 可以說：[[R&S CMX500]] 是本合作中被明示使用的平台。
- 可以說：合作方向包含 advanced orbit and channel emulation capabilities for NTN use cases。
- 不可說：本來源證明某個 [[R&S CMX500]] option code、hardware configuration、frequency band、satellite orbit、channel model 或 3GPP release 已正式支援。
- 正式配置仍需回 [[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]]、[[CMX_Configuration_Guide_NR-NTN]]、[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]。

[[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]] 明示 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[R&S SMBV100B]] 與 [[MediaTek]] NTN-NR device as DUT 共同用於 demo setup：

- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] radio communication tester simulate the satellite base station。
- [[R&S SMBV100B]] vector signal generator simulate different satellite constellations with its integrated GNSS option。
- [[R&S CMX500]] operate in interactive callbox mode，讓 users trigger voice calls alongside RF-related measurements。

[[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]] 明示 [[Viasat NB-NTN IoT test plan]] based on [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 versatile solution designed for testing various NTN technologies，包括 [[NR-NTN]] 與 [[NB-NTN]]。
- PR 稱 single instrument covers R&D through certification and carrier acceptance tests，並提供 reliable and repeatable results。
- 此為 PR / solution-level claim；正式 configuration、license stack、measurement uncertainty、supported bands、NB-NTN test cases 與 carrier acceptance scope 未在來源中列出。

5G NTN validation and testing › 來源中的測試目標
依 [[Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing]]，[[Gatehouse Satcom]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的合作目標包含：

- strengthen validation and testing of [[5G IoT-NTN]] and [[NR-NTN]] technologies。
- 在市場從 specification work 走向 real-world implementation 時，改善 validation 方法。
- 在 realistic and controlled laboratory conditions 下測試 5G NTN technologies。
- further develop advanced orbit and channel emulation capabilities for NTN use cases。
- 支援更準確的 satellite radio channel modelling。
- 更 realistic testing of 5G NTN behavior across different scenarios。
- 支援 faster validation cycles、earlier identification of system-level issues 與 stronger test conditions。
- reduce technical uncertainty and accelerate time to market for the broader NTN ecosystem。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]]，MWC 2024 展示目標包含：

- demonstrate a [[5G Non-Terrestrial Network]] [[New Radio]] connection based on latest [[3GPP Release 17]] specifications。
- emulate a [[Low Earth Orbit]] satellite access node。
- showcase 5G technology providing connectivity in areas without terrestrial coverage。
- 展示 basic mobile services，例如 voice、messaging 與 low data rate services，面向 maritime、aeronautical 與 rural applications。
- 在 interactive callbox mode 中讓 users trigger voice calls alongside RF-related measurements。
- 評估 future NTN-NR devices powered by [[MediaTek]] NTN test platform 在不同 conditions 下的 performance and reliability。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]]，[[Viasat]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 NB-NTN IoT test plan 目標包含：

5G NTN validation and testing › 來源中的測試目標
- boost testing for [[Narrowband Non-terrestrial Networks]]（[[NB-NTN]]）[[IoT]] devices connecting via satellite。
- thoroughly validate devices and confirm interoperability with [[Viasat]] network。
- help ensure uninterrupted connectivity for satellite-based [[IoT]] applications。
- ensure chipsets、modules and devices interoperate seamlessly with [[Viasat]] satellite network。
- comply with [[3GPP Release 17]] standards。
- uphold quality、performance and reliability for [[Viasat]] connectivity services in areas without terrestrial network coverage。
- certification test plan entails protocol、performance and RF test scenarios。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

NTN test and measurement aspects
[[NTN test and measurement aspects]] 是 [[5G-NTN-takes-flight-A-deep-dive_wp_en_3673-3210-52_v0100]] 對 NTN device、satellite、SAN、payload、phased array antenna、network 與 production testing 的總覽，涵蓋 RF、protocol、RRM、LBS、conformance、OTA、field testing 與 software-assisted testing。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[EN 303 981]] 測試描述為 antenna characterizations 的 radiated measurement，列出 antenna beam pointing、off/on-axis spurious radiation、carrier suppression / cessation、blocking performance、adjacent signal selectivity、image frequency rejection、WBES location / identification、control and monitoring functions、receive antenna off-axis gain pattern，並連到 [[R&S SMBV100B]]、[[R&S ELEKTRA]]、[[R&S TS8996]]。
- 來源列出 FCC CFR47 §25 Mobile Satellite Service / Mobile Earth Station test items：RF output power、occupied bandwidth、emission mask within 25% of authorized BW、out of band emissions、additional unwanted emission 1559–1610 MHz、carrier-off state emissions 1559–1610 MHz、frequency stability，並提到 ANSI C63.26 / FCC KDBs。
- 最後來源把 primary test instruments for wireless regulatory test labs 分成 wireless communication tester、EMI test receiver、signal & spectrum analyzer、network analyzer、vector signal generator、broadband amplifier 等類別。

passages.text:
Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源指出 smartphone Art 3.3g / [[Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019-320]] / E112 是沒有 ETSI EN standard 的 regulatory compliance requirement；當沒有 EN standard available 時需 Notified body involved，並稱 [[R&S TS-LBS]] 是 first test solution available to perform the necessary LBS compliance tests。
- [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]部分列出 [[47 CFR]]、[[ANSI C63.26]]、[[ANSI C63.10]]、[[IEEE Std 1528-2013]]、[[C63.19]] 等測試依據，並列出 licensed cellular CFR47 test items：RF power output、modulation characteristics、occupied bandwidth、band edge、spurious emissions、frequency stability、peak to average ratio、field strength of spurious radiation。
- 來源以 [[ITU-R SM.329-12]] 與 [[47 CFR §2.1057]] 對照 CE RED / FCC 的 frequency range：5G NR FR1 的 CE RED 30 MHz–26 GHz、FCC 9 kHz–40 GHz；5G NR FR2 的 CE RED 30 MHz–90 GHz、FCC 9 kHz–200 GHz；並提到 [[R&S FSV3000]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S ESW]]。
- [[NTN 裝置法規測試]]部分把 NTN device implementation 分成 proprietary、3GPP < R16、3GPP R17 NTN-IoT、reuse spectrum assets / 3GPP unmodified UE 等路徑，例子包含 iPhone 14 / Globalstar、Qualcomm / Iridium、MTK / Bullitt / Skylo、AT&T / AST Space Mobile、T-Mobile / Starlink、Optus / Lynk。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 Rohde & Schwarz application brochure《Satellite payload and components testing》，文件代碼 `PD 5215.2120.92`，Version 02.00，文件日期標示 `September 2022 (ch)`，主題是使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器測試 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、transponders、modules 與 components。

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：提供 satellite payload and components test and measurement solutions。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]]：文件頁尾 copyright owner，© 2017–2022，地址標示 81671 Munich, Germany。
- [[R&S FSW]]：用於 group delay、linearity、NPR、signal quality、spurious、carrier-in-carrier 與 oscillator / synthesizer measurements；來源列 key features 為 up to 90 GHz、up to 500 GHz with external harmonic mixers、up to 8.3 GHz internal analysis bandwidth、800 MHz real-time analysis bandwidth。
- [[R&S SMW200A]]：用於 multi-carrier / modulated signal generation、OFDM waveform generation、DPD、NPR stimulus；來源列 key features 為 up to 67 GHz、up to 2 GHz I/Q modulation bandwidth、with [[R&S SMW-K555]] 可達 4 GHz signal bandwidth、optional second RF path up to 44 GHz。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：用於 payload components RF measurements、converter / mixer group delay、noise figure、amplifier/filter/antenna measurements；來源列 key features 包含 up to 67 GHz、up to eight independent receivers、four phase coherent sources、two internal LO sources、internal combiner。
- [[R&S FS-SNS]]：smart noise source，用於簡化 spectrum analyzer 的 noise figure and gain measurements。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]：TVAC-compatible automatic calibration unit，可放在 chamber 內做 inline recalibration。
- [[R&S NRP33SN-V]] 與 [[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：TVAC-designed three-path diode power sensors，分別支援 up to 33 GHz / 67 GHz。
- [[R&S RTP]]、[[R&S RTO6]]：oscilloscopes，用於 satellite digital interface trigger、decode 與 debug。
- [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]：本來源的總題目。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：比較 spectrum analyzer + signal generator 與 VNA two-tone technique 的測試主題。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下 satellite payload qualification 測試主題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]]、[[Group delay]]、[[NPR]]、[[EVM]]、[[OFDM]]、[[Spurious emissions]]、[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Network densification、small cells、production 與 private networks
- Slide 25 network densification 包含 FWA for last mile、mmWave radios、sub-6 small cells、repeaters。
- Slide 26 將 [[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S FSV]]、[[R&S FE44A]]、[[R&S CMQ200]]、[[R&S RTP]] / [[R&S RTO]]、[[R&S ZNA]] 等列於 chamber / conformance、small cells、embedded design & power、RF design and compliance 脈絡。
- Slide 27 提出 high-volume testing of mmWave small cells and radio units，產品 / 方案包含 [[R&S CMPHEAD30]]、Wireless Manufacturing Test（WMT），並宣稱 fully validated in QDART、ultrafast measurement speed、parallel testing of multiple DUTs、supported RF bands 29 / 39 / 47、fully automated path correction concept。
- Slide 28–29 private networks 以 healthcare、industries & manufacturers、transport、enterprises / campus / stadiums、mission critical communications、smart city / neutral hosts 等為應用，強調 site acceptance、data analytics、service monitoring、spectrum clearance & interference hunting。
- Slide 30 將 network infrastructure architecture 分為 antenna、RU / radio unit、BBU / baseband unit 與 mobile network，測試活動包含 design & validation、R&D、conformance、calibration、Rx/Tx tests、go/no-go tests、network measurement / analysis / troubleshooting / monitoring、baseband verification、functional performance、RF parametric、RF component & digital design、baseband algorithm、transmitter / receiver / performance tests。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › MIMO、Beamforming 與 OTA
- Slide 4 定義 [[Beamforming]]：透過 bundling transmitted energy 並將能量導向 user 以增加 antenna gain。
- Slide 4 定義 [[MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 many antennas，用於增加 capacity。
- Slide 4 定義 [[Massive MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 very high number of antenna elements，結合 beamforming 與 spatial multiplexing。
- Slide 4 說 operators with mid-band spectrum 對 Massive MIMO 較有信心，例子包括 China、US；並說 beamforming 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- Slide 5 以 `Up to nx8 MIMO Generation & Analysis`、5G NR multi-channel analysis、integrated fading simulation，連到 [[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。
- Slide 6 對 beamforming components / accuracy 提出 fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument；產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（18 GHz–90 GHz ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）。
- Slide 7 說 Active Antennas 與 Massive MIMO 使 measured systems 更複雜，高頻使 conducted testing impractical，far-field 條件量測需要 sophisticated T&M solutions；並說 higher frequencies / Massive MIMO 下 OTA testing 將成為必要。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Digital Design & Power / Energy saving
- Slide 14–15 將 highspeed digital and power designs 定位為需要快速、可靠、準確 T&M tools 的 verification / debugging 領域，測試工具包括 [[VNA]]、probes、phase noise analyzer、power supplies、multimeter、oscilloscopes、signal source。
- Slide 16 說 rising energy costs drive MNOs to boost efficiency，base stations and components offer substantial energy-saving potential。
- Slide 17 提出 optimization of power consumption、power statistics over time、device activity versus power consumption、real-time power / voltage / current statistics、up to 800 W / up to four channels；產品包括 [[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07 voltage probe、RT-ZC31 current probe。
- Slide 18 提到 measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers、envelope signal for tracker generated in real-time、turnkey solution based on VSG + VSA + SW、dedicated SW applications for Doherty、[[R&S SMW-K546]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K18]]。
- Slide 19 提出 PA load-pull testing，用於確認 PA 在 final design 看到不同 impedance 時的 behavior。

Starlink UT Test Flow › 關鍵實體與概念

5G NR conducted base station receiver tests › Chapter 7 test cases
依 [[GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests]]（12.2020），GFM314 覆蓋下列 [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] chapter 7 receiver tests：

| Test case | 名稱 | 來源摘要 |
|---|---|---|
| 7.2 | Reference Sensitivity Level | 測量 receiver 在 reference sensitivity power level `PREFSENS` 下是否滿足 reference measurement channel throughput requirement。 |
| 7.3 | Dynamic Range | 測量 receiver 在 received channel bandwidth 內存在 [[AWGN]] interferer 時接收 wanted signal 的能力。 |
| 7.4.1 | Adjacent Channel Selectivity（ACS） | 測量 receiver 在相鄰通道 5G NR interferer 存在時接收 assigned channel wanted signal 的能力。 |
| 7.4.2a | In-band Blocking: General | 以 NR interferer center frequency 1 MHz step size 掃描，測量 in-band blocking。 |
| 7.4.2b | In-band Blocking: Narrow-band blocking | 類似 ACS，但 interfering signal 只包含 1 resource block。 |
| 7.5 | Out-of-band Blocking | 以 CW interferer 進行 out-of-band blocking 掃頻測試。 |
| 7.6 | Receiver Spurious Emissions | 測量 receiver 產生或放大的 emissions 出現在 BS receiver antenna connector 的功率。 |
| 7.7 | Receiver Intermodulation | 測量 two interfering signals（CW + QPSK NR signal）造成 intermodulation effect 時 receiver 接收 wanted signal 的能力。 |
| 7.8 | In-channel selectivity | 測量較高 PSD interferer 存在下，receiver 在 assigned RB locations 接收 wanted signal 的能力。 |

Starlink User Terminal › Regulatory / certification 語境
來源提到：

- FCC USA：Part 15 WLAN router、Part 25 NGSO satellite、SAR / MPE testing。
- Taiwan NCC：Fixed satellite service compliance、Ku-band uplink overlap review。
- Labs：[[Bureau Veritas]] Taoyuan、local R&S / Keysight partnerships for emissions。
- Key limits：EIRP density、PFD at ground、interference mitigation、beacon power。
- Timeline：DVT certification 3–6 months、PVT production ramp post-approval。

⚠️ [[Starlink UT Test Flow]]（2026-09-18 raw converted）說 NCC/FCC certification: Taiwan labs，且 Labs: Bureau Veritas (Taoyuan), local R&S/Keysight partnerships for emissions；但既有頁面 [[NCC]] 說 NCC 在衛星 / 通訊監理語境應連到 [[國家通訊傳播委員會]]，不是測試實驗室。判斷：本來源可能把監理機關、認證流程與實驗室混寫；在取得 NCC 公告或 Bureau Veritas scope 前，不把 NCC 寫成 lab。

Starlink User Terminal › DVT / PVT test flow
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 列出 key steps：

- Functional test：power on、stow、normal / obstructed state check。
- RF emissions：anechoic chamber、FCC Part 15 / 25 limits、spurious <-43 dBc。
- EIRP / G/T：spectrum analyzer + power meter measurement、validate against target。
- Modulation BER：connect to gateway simulator、QPSK / 64QAM threshold test。
- Environmental：thermal cycle、drop / vibration、IP67 salt spray、snowmelt power。

更完整測試流程另見 [[Starlink User Terminal 測試流程]]。

Starlink User Terminal › RF performance 指標
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 列出下列 key RF metrics：

- [[EIRP]]：32–43 dBW peak；FCC Part 25 limits；uplink PFD -146 dBW/m²。
- G/T：約 11.5 dB/K；antenna gain 37–39 dBi；noise figure 2–2.5 dB。
- Return Loss / VSWR：>14 dB / <1.5:1；來源稱 impedance match critical。
- Phase Noise：<-92 dBc/Hz @100 kHz；來源連到 Shiraz beamformer stability。
- Modulation / BER：QPSK / 64QAM；BER <10⁻⁶ at Eb/N0 4–10 dB。

上述每一項都缺少測試條件、頻段、儀器配置、sample size、terminal revision 與引用來源。

ETS-Lindgren OTA turnkey testing solutions › 來源中的架構
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and ETS-Lindgren partner to offer OTA testing solutions for next-gen wireless technologies]]，solution elements 包含：

| 元件 | 來源描述 |
|---|---|
| [[R&S CMX500]] | one-box signaling tester；支援 [[4G LTE]]、[[5G NR]] [[5G FR1]] / [[5G FR2]]、latest [[5G RedCap]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] up to [[Wi-Fi 7]]。 |
| [[R&S SMBV100B]] | vector signal generator；ultra-high output power、fully calibrated wideband signal generation、full featured [[GNSS constellation simulator]]。 |
| [[ETS-Lindgren]] anechoic chambers / chamber technology | 與 R&S instruments 整合，形成 OTA testing turnkey solutions。 |
| [[EMQuest]] software | 已整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 與 [[R&S SMBV100B]]，作為 overall system 的 software layer。 |

ETS-Lindgren OTA turnkey testing solutions › 支援技術與測試情境
來源列出的 supported / covered technologies：

- [[4G]] / [[4G LTE]]。
- [[5G NR]] [[5G FR1]]。
- [[5G NR]] [[5G FR2]]。
- [[5G RedCap]] / [[RedCap]]。
- [[Wi-Fi]] up to [[Wi-Fi 7]]。
- [[A-GNSS]] scenarios using [[R&S SMBV100B]] + [[R&S CMX500]] under controlled conditions。
- [[Bluetooth]]。
- [[Narrowband NTN]]。

來源稱 integrated solutions are [[CTIA]] certified for [[4G]] and [[5G FR1]] and support both [[SISO]] and [[MIMO]]。來源也稱 4G / 5G carrier combinations 可使用 carrier aggregation across hundreds of channels and bands。

- 來源未標示新聞稿發布日期。
- 來源未提供 [[EMQuest]] software version、license option、test sequence list 或 automation interface。
